snippet.title: The Last Starship V1.0 Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
The Last Starship is a 2D space construction game where you design and upgrade your starship. Choose your path: pirate hunter, miner, engineer, spacebus driver, and more, whilst exploring vibrant star systems.

From acclaimed indie game developer Introversion Software (Prison Architect, DEFCON, Darwinia and others)  and after years of perfecting in early access the game launches on 3 Feb 2026.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1857080/The_Last_Starship/
